title: Paper Lanterns Astra v1
identity: Warm buoyant lantern-light theme built from dotted-quarter calls answered by quick stepwise descents, opening once per chorus into a rising major sixth.

title: Blue Window Astra v1
identity: Wistful and spacious: long descending sustains answered by offbeat eighth-note pairs, minor-tinged verses opening into a wide chorus.

title: Northbound Lights Astra v1
identity: A forward-driving eighth-note pulse that springs up a perfect fourth, answered in the chorus by syncopated off-beat anticipations landing on long held notes over an E-minor-lifted D major loop.

title: After the Rain Astra v1
identity: Every phrase enters a half-beat late and climbs in three-note stepwise groups, so the lead sounds like it keeps gathering courage; the chorus arches up to a held peak and then walks back down by steps into open space.
